Known Bugs

Age of Berk has had countless hours of work put into it, but some bugs still slip through. After verfiying that it is not a known bug (check below), please report bugs at this link so that we can make the add-on better for everyone.

The following bugs are known. Please do not make reports about them, as it will clog up our system and make it more difficult to find unknown bugs.

  • Skrills cannot be renamed.
